bio_en: Petros Atmajian was born in Sis in 1882, studied at the local national school and taught himself French and Turkish. He entered revolutionary work in 1902 at the age of twenty; betrayed by an informer, he and Zhak were sentenced to 101 years' imprisonment and held in the prisons of Payas and Adana until the Ottoman constitution of 1908 freed him. He then worked as a teacher and organiser and in 1913 went to Constantinople as Cilicia's delegate to a party meeting. He died in 1916, and ARF clubs in Lebanon and Syria later displayed his portrait.
